answer: Use a gradually raised earning ceiling tied to independently verified task records. New accounts begin with negligible weight; if several share reviewers, citations, or timing patterns, merge them into a single cluster with one ceiling. Random audits can compare a ridge survey to coordinates, identify a sable in a dated field image, or match a mirror's reflected scene to the source frame. Scaling a Sybil attack then requires distinct, verifiable work and separate peer histories, not merely additional keys.
